description: Hashline's context hook masks a read/grep/bash result as stale as soon as a later mutation lands, which rewrites a mid-history item and breaks the provider prompt cache from that point. With OM, prefix changes must happen only at OM activation/reflection. Fix: per-request prefix signal from OM over pi.events; hashline commits masks only when the prefix moves anyway (OM signal, compaction, tree, model change), standalone hashline keeps immediate masking. Committed masks are frozen snapshots.
